claims.statement: For every arbitrary rank sequence r_k>=2, the fresh fair-selector tower F_1=A(wP), F_k=A(Q_{r_k}F_{k-1}) satisfies G(F_d)<=2^{-d}G(P)+24 and transfers every base GU' inequality with additive a-cost 24 while preserving b<1 exactly.
claims.scope: Positive point-defect balancers Q_r of mean 1-2^{1-r}; fresh disjoint blocks; fair outer selectors; arbitrary finite depth and rank sequence.

claims.statement: For the same tower, U(P)<=5I(P) implies U(F_d)<=5I(F_d) and H(F_d)<=12I(F_d) at every finite depth.
claims.scope: Same proper class; constant 5 is sufficient and not claimed sharp.

claims.statement: No dimension-independent aggregate control is proved for arbitrary balancers, negative near-constant bias, biased outer selectors, overlap, variable reuse, or changing coherent cores.
